name: N-acetylcysteine

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: The acetylated form of cysteine, a rate-limiting glutathione precursor. FDA-approved as a prescription antidote for paracetamol overdose and as a mucolytic; separately sold as a dietary supplement, a status the FDA has contested.

systems.note: Glutathione repletion; the basis of the approved antidote indication and of supplemental use.
Studied for glutamatergic modulation in compulsive and psychiatric conditions.
Anaphylactoid reactions are labelled for the intravenous route.

monitors.why: Glutathione repletion is the hepatic rationale it is taken under.
